replies.body: What's f-a? Like goal difference? And if so how does it work?
replies.body_tagged: What's f-a? Like goal difference? And if so how does it work?

replies.author: faht
replies.body:
Yep
F = For, how many goals the team has scored.
A = Against, how many goals the team has conceded.

Instead of goals, monuments/wools captured.
